other_failure_modes.name: Data leakage during cross-validation
other_failure_modes.description: Transformations like scaling or imputation are applied to the entire training set before cross-validation splitting, rather than being fit inside the CV loop on the training folds only. This leaks validation fold statistics into the training folds.

other_failure_modes.name: Unhandled missing values causing crash
other_failure_modes.description: The code applies a scikit-learn transformer (like StandardScaler) that does not support missing values to raw data without prior imputation. This will cause a runtime ValueError if the dataset contains any NaNs.

other_failure_modes.name: Invalid early stopping configuration
other_failure_modes.description: The agent attempts to use an early stopping callback when training a model, but fails to provide a validation set. In libraries like LightGBM, this causes a fatal runtime error as there is no metric to monitor for early stopping.

summary: The agent builds a LightGBM model with 5-fold cross-validation but suffers from multiple critical execution flaws. It applies StandardScaler before handling missing values (which will crash on datasets with NaNs like ILPD) and erroneously configures early stopping on the final model without a validation set, guaranteeing a failure. Additionally, scaling the data prior to the CV loop causes data leakage, and there is a complete absence of data cleaning and feature engineering.
